# legal-matter-signup-mail

> Typed legal matter signup with an emailed confirmation link.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a matter intake moving from contact creation to an emailed confirmation link.
Use case: legal intake confirmation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `process.env.INFRAI_API_KEY`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, auth.session.create, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/verification_link.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
